figures.Fig10.7: Figure 10.7 An electrochemical cell, made by connecting a Cu2+/Cu half-cell to a Zn2+/Zn half-cell (PDF page 229). Original figure archived as c11-chem-ch10-fig-10-7-cu-zn-cell (drawn for this lesson after the printed figure; not the textbook's picture). The printed figure draws the arrows on the connecting wire pointing from the copper (+) electrode to the zinc (-) electrode while labelling the wire e-; electrons flow from the negative to the positive terminal, so the arrows are drawn from zinc (-) to copper (+) (correct).

findings: Figure 10.7 draws the wire arrows from copper (+) to zinc (-) while labelling them e-; the redrawn figure shows electron flow from zinc to copper, as the book's text states, and the Roman Urdu lesson notes the correction.
